target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Primary animal shelter serving Ashtabula County. Mission: Provide temporary homes for parent-less pets until finding the best possible 'furever' home. Promotes spay/neuter, responsible pet ownership, companion pet education. Full-service shelter with adoptable pets, foster program, rescue partnerships, volunteer coordination. Accepts monetary donations, in-kind donations (food, supplies), sponsorships. Amazon and Chewy wishlists. A matching platform with detailed pet profiles and adoption applications would streamline their adoption process.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Local humane society handling pet adoptions and animal welfare in Ashtabula County. Provides adoption services with trained staff to answer questions and concerns. Focus on helping families introduce new pets. Emphasizes that pet ownership is 'one of the most gratifying things you can do.' Digital tools for pet matching and volunteer coordination would support their mission.

acapl.mission: Provide temporary homes for the parent-less pets of Ashtabula County until we can find them the best possible 'furever' home
programs: Adoption - browse adoptable pets awaiting families
Foster - in-home care for dogs, cats, puppies, kittens, exotic animals
Rescue - work with rescue groups, animals come fully vetted
Volunteer - walk dogs, play with cats, help at events, cleaning, laundry
support_channels: Monetary donations - directly supports care, shelter, medical treatment
Sponsorships - sponsor events, programs, specific pets, adoption fees
